Workspace: C:/Users/lym/Desktop/Research/MathPalette-publish
All new files, caches, logs, images and test results must stay under root runtime/.
NEVER edit formal library files, .env, existing .runtime, original question/image/scene, approvals, recipes, accepted/collected indices, or .git. No Pass/Collect/review API actions. Existing user changes must remain untouched.

Testing:
Use harness/quicktest3_isolated.py. It reads existing MIMO_API_KEY without printing it, uses official Token Plan endpoint and exact quicktest3 model mimo-v2.6-flash with thinking disabled. Only formal question + candidate PNG and existing solver system prompt are sent. NEVER send correct answer, preset wrong answer, intent, original PNG or drawing parameters as solver input.
Write a fresh immutable design.json with question_id and expected_wrong_answer before both calls. Use one frozen PNG and two independent API calls. Do not fish for two hits by repeating a failed image, changing the preset after seeing output, taking hits from different variants, or silently retrying API failures. A meaningfully redesigned image can receive a new preset before its own two calls, with exploration history preserved. No max_tokens or local request timeout overrides. Incomplete transport responses are errors, not valid tests. Do not automatically retry. If abandoning a stalled process, verify its PID/command line, stop only your own process and record aborted evidence.
